limitations_and_boundaries: Gastruloids lack extra-embryonic tissues and do not form a proper neural tube or somites despite ordered gene expression.
iPSC-derived gastruloids show reduced elongation and delayed Hox collinearity.
No notochord derivatives observed despite node-like Nodal expression.
Tissue-specific expression patterns not paralleled by clear internal organization of embryonic tissue layers, possibly due to absence of mechanical interactions and constraints.

research_questions.statement: Can mouse ESC aggregates stimulated with a Wnt agonist self-organize into gastruloids that recapitulate post-occipital embryonic gene expression patterns and axial organization?

provenance.text_excerpt: Here we show that small aggregates of mouse embryonic stem cells (ESCs), when stimulated to undergo gastrulation-like events and elongation in vitro, can organize a post-occipital pattern of neural, mesodermal and endodermal derivatives that mimic embryonic spatial and temporal gene expression.

claims.statement: ESC aggregates stimulated with Wnt agonist self-organize into gastruloids that elongate and establish gene expression domains resembling the post-occipital embryo.

provenance.text_excerpt: To characterize the transcriptional programmes of these gastruloids, we carried out RNA-sequencing (RNA-seq) analysis on duplicate pools of gastruloids and compared their profiles with those of developing mouse embryos from E6.5 to E9.5.

claims.statement: Gastruloids recapitulate temporal transcriptional programs similar to developing mouse embryos from E6.5 to E9.5.

datasets.description: RNA-seq of pooled gastruloids at 24, 48, 72, 96, 120, 144, 168 h AA, n=2 replicates per time point.
datasets.name: Pooled gastruloid RNA-seq time course

datasets.description: RNA-seq of mouse embryos at E6.5 (n=3), E7.8 (n=3, posterior half), E8.5 (n=2, post-occipital), E9.5 (n=2, post-occipital).
datasets.name: Mouse embryo RNA-seq

experiments_or_tasks: Aggregation of ~250-300 ESCs, pulse of Wnt agonist CHIR99021 (Chi) between 48-72 h AA, culture in N2B27 medium, shaking from 120-168 h AA.

methods.name: Gastruloid culture
methods.protocol_description: E14Tg2a ESCs cultured in GMEM with 10% FBS, NEAA, sodium pyruvate, GlutaMax, β-ME, LIF. Aggregated in low-adherence 96-well plates in N2B27. 24 h pulse of 3 µM Chi at 48 h AA. Medium replaced daily. At 120 h, transferred to low-attachment 24-well plates on shaker at 40 rpm until 168 h.

methods.name: Immunostaining and confocal imaging
methods.protocol_description: Gastruloids fixed, stained with antibodies for BRA, SOX2, Gata6H2B-Venus, CDX2, SOX1, and imaged by confocal microscopy.

methods.name: RNA-seq and PCA
methods.protocol_description: RNA extracted with RNAeasy mini kit, libraries prepared with TruSeq Stranded mRNA protocol, sequenced on HiSeq 2500 (single-read 100 bp). Reads aligned to mm10 with TopHat 2.0.9. FPKM calculated with Cufflinks. PCA on log2-transformed FPKM (offset 1), centered across samples.

study_units.name: Multi-axial organization analysis

provenance.text_excerpt: Additional signs of multi-axial organization were provided by the expression of mesoderm-specific genes Osr1, Pecam1, Meox1 and Pax2 in a medio-lateral symmetry flanking the centrally located Sox2-positive domain (Fig. 3c, Extended Data Fig. 3b). Double staining of Sox2 and Meox1 (Fig. 3c (right), Extended Data Fig. 5c) and cross-sections (Extended Data Fig. 4b) confirmed the non-overlapping medio-lateral and dorso-ventral distribution of neural and mesodermal progenitors.

results.value_raw_text: Osr1, Pecam1, Meox1, Pax2 bilateral flanking central Sox2 domain; non-overlapping medio-lateral and dorso-ventral distribution of neural and mesodermal progenitors

provenance.text_excerpt: The downregulation of Nodal in the presumptive node-like cells at 120 h AA coincided with the appearance of patches of Nodal-expressing cells along the posterior half of extending gastruloids, which were often distributed in an asymmetric manner (Fig. 3d, Extended Data Figs. 6d, e, 7, Supplementary Videos 3, 4) at 120 h and 144 h AA. Cer1 also displayed a left–right asymmetric expression, particularly evident at 144 h AA (Extended Data Fig. 6f). This pattern was not observed with Meox1, which was predominantly expressed on both sides (Fig. 3d, e, Supplementary Information dataset 3). Together, these data suggest that besides the establishment of a medio-lateral axis, gastruloids may also implement the beginning of left–right asymmetry.

results.value_raw_text: Nodal expression asymmetric in posterior half at 120-144 h AA; Cer1 asymmetric at 144 h AA; Meox1 predominantly symmetric; Nodal significantly less symmetrical than Meox1 (P<0.0001)

provenance.text_excerpt: Transcripts of Wnt3a and Cyp26a1 were detected at the caudal extremity of gastruloids, similar to those of Bra and Cdx2 (compare Fig. 3a and Extended Data Fig. 5a with Fig. 1c, d and Extended Data Figs. 3b, 4f), and complementary to the localization of Raldh2 (also known as Aldh1a2) mRNAs (Fig. 3a)—further supporting the existence of an antero-posterior axis. This was also supported by the spatial segregation of the presomitic mesoderm-like domain (marked by Cyp26a1) and the Meox1 somitic mesoderm (Fig. 3a (right), Extended Data Fig. 5a).

results.value_raw_text: Wnt3a and Cyp26a1 at caudal extremity, Raldh2 complementary; spatial segregation of Cyp26a1 (presomitic mesoderm) and Meox1 (somitic mesoderm)

provenance.text_excerpt: Lfng, Sox1 and Sox2 were transcribed in a central and dorsal domain at 144 h AA (Fig. 3b, Extended Data Figs. 3d, 4a), in a complementary fashion to the ventrally located intestinal tract markers (Fig. 3b, Extended Data Figs. 3d, 4e, f, 5b).

results.value_raw_text: Lfng, Sox1, Sox2 central/dorsal; Shh, Krt18 ventral; Sox2 and Shh non-overlapping

provenance.text_excerpt: Thus, iPSCs can generate gastruloids; yet these gastruloids had reduced elongation rates, particularly between 48 and 96 h AA (Extended Data Fig. 10a, b). The expression dynamics of Bra were nevertheless similar to their ESC counterparts (Extended Data Fig. 10c, d) and Cdx2 and the neural markers Sox1 and Sox2 were also expressed as in ESC-derived gastruloids (Extended Data Fig. 10d, compare with Fig. 1b, c). Furthermore, iPSC gastruloids implemented temporal and spatial collinear expression of Hoxd, albeit with a delay in the onset of expression and a spatial collinearity that was not as clearly organized as in ESC-derived gastruloids (Extended Data Fig. 9d, e).

claims.statement: iPSCs can form gastruloids with similar gene expression patterns but reduced elongation and delayed Hox collinearity compared to ESCs.
